topics.welcome:
Welcome to Rein! This is a public space for all community members to learn, share and build together. Read the pinned guide to find your channel. Be respectful; no harassment, discrimination, spam or sharing private information.

欢迎加入 Rein！这里是面向所有社区成员的公共空间，一起学习、分享与协作。请阅读置顶导航，找到感兴趣的频道。尊重彼此，不骚扰、歧视、刷屏或泄露隐私。
topics.resources:
Browse Rein documentation and learning resources in this read-only channel. To recommend a resource or report a broken link, post in #feedback with the link and a short explanation. Credit the original source and share only material you have permission to share.

在这个只读频道浏览 Rein 文档与学习资源。推荐资源或反馈失效链接，请到 #feedback 附上链接和简短说明。注明原始出处，只分享有权公开的材料。
topics.announcements:
Read official Rein updates, project releases and event notices. This channel is read-only. Discuss updates in #general or ask event questions in #events; link to the announcement so others can follow the context.

查看 Rein 正式公告、项目发布与活动通知。本频道只读。公告讨论请到 #general，活动问题请到 #events；附上原公告链接，方便大家了解背景。
topics.general:
A public conversation space for all community members: ask questions, share ideas and get to know one another. Mention @Nori for help. Keep discussions constructive; no harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, spam or private information.

面向所有社区成员的公共交流空间：提问、分享想法、认识伙伴；需要帮助时可 @Nori。友善讨论、对事不对人，不骚扰、歧视、人身攻击、刷屏或公开他人隐私。
topics.introductions:
Introduce yourself if you would like: your preferred name, interests and what you hope to learn or share. Welcome others without pressure to respond. Share only what you are comfortable making public; do not ask for private contact details.

愿意的话，介绍你的称呼、兴趣，以及希望学习或分享的内容。欢迎新朋友，也尊重只想旁观或暂不回复的成员。只分享愿意公开的信息，不索取他人私人联系方式。
topics.events:
Share public events and meetups, ask participation questions and discuss your experience. For confirmed events, include the date, timezone, location, cost and registration link when available; label early ideas as proposals. Use a thread per event. No repeated advertising or pressure to attend; ask consent before sharing photos of others.

分享公开活动与聚会，询问参与方式，交流活动体验。已确认的活动请尽量附上日期、时区、地点、费用和报名链接；筹划中的想法请注明尚未确定。每场活动使用独立线程。不重复刷广告或强迫参与，发布他人照片前先征得同意。
topics.feedback:
Share suggestions, resource recommendations or problems with the community and its tools. Explain what happened and what you expected; a proposed solution is welcome but not required. Include sources for recommendations. Critique ideas, not people; no harassment or personal attacks. Send sensitive details privately to a moderator.

分享社区与工具的建议、资源推荐或遇到的问题。说明发生了什么、你期待什么；有改进想法欢迎提出，没有解决方案也可以反馈。推荐资源请注明出处。对事不对人，不骚扰或人身攻击；涉及隐私的细节请私下联系管理员。
topics.projects:
Share a project, post progress or invite collaborators. Describe the goal, current stage and help you would welcome; add public links when available and use one thread per project. Credit contributors and respect licenses. Keep invitations voluntary; no repeated promotion, unsolicited tagging or sharing private project information.

展示项目、分享进展或邀请协作。介绍目标、当前阶段和希望获得的帮助，有公开链接可以附上；每个项目使用独立线程。尊重贡献者署名与许可，让成员自愿参与。不重复刷屏、随意点名拉人或公开项目私密信息。
topics.development:
Discuss code, agents, protocols and integrations, or ask for technical help. Include relevant versions, reproduction steps and sanitized errors; use threads for separate issues. Be patient with beginners. Never post passwords, tokens or private data.

讨论代码、Agent、协议与集成，或寻求技术帮助。提问附相关版本、复现步骤和已脱敏的错误信息，不同问题使用独立线程。耐心对待新手，不发布密码、令牌或私人数据。
topics.ask-nori:
Ask Nori directly, without a mention: learn about Rein, find learning resources and public events, or explore ways to participate. Give enough context for your question. This channel is public; keep conversations respectful and do not share private information, passwords or tokens.

直接向 Nori 提问，无需 @：了解 Rein、寻找学习资源与公开活动，或探索参与方式。请提供与问题相关的背景。这里是公共频道，请友善交流，勿发布个人隐私、密码或令牌。

welcomeGuide:
**Welcome to Rein**
A public space for all community members to learn, share and build together. Join at your own pace; introductions are optional.

**Find your channel**
• {{announcements}} — Official updates (read-only)
• {{resources}} — Documentation and learning resources (read-only)
• {{introductions}} — Say hello, share your interests
• {{general}} — Questions, ideas and everyday conversation
• {{events}} — Public events and participation questions
• {{feedback}} — Suggestions, resource recommendations and issues
• {{projects}} — Projects, progress and collaborators
• {{development}} — Code and technical help
• {{ask-nori}} — Ask Nori directly, no mention needed

**Participate with care**
Stay on topic and use threads for separate discussions. Disagree respectfully: no harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks or spam. Credit sources and respect consent. Never share private information or credentials; report sensitive concerns privately to a moderator.

Website: https://rein-protocol.org

**欢迎加入 Rein**
这里是面向所有社区成员的公共空间，一起学习、分享与协作。按自己的节奏参与，自我介绍完全自愿。

**频道导航**
• {{announcements}} — 正式公告（只读）
• {{resources}} — 文档与学习资料（只读）
• {{introductions}} — 介绍自己与兴趣
• {{general}} — 提问、想法与日常交流
• {{events}} — 公开活动与参与交流
• {{feedback}} — 建议、资源推荐与问题反馈
• {{projects}} — 项目展示、进展与协作
• {{development}} — 代码讨论与技术求助
• {{ask-nori}} — 直接向 Nori 提问，无需 @

**交流约定**
围绕频道主题交流，不同话题使用线程。可以有不同意见，请对事不对人；不骚扰、歧视、威胁、人身攻击或刷屏。分享注明出处，尊重他人的参与意愿。勿公开个人隐私或凭据；涉及隐私的情况请私下联系管理员。

官网：https://rein-protocol.org
